intro_notes: At Chipotle you build your own meal, so protein depends on what you add. Its High Protein Menu lists ready-made orders from 15 g to 81 g of protein, and Chipotle labels two of them, the High Protein - Low Calorie Bowl and the High Protein-High Fiber Bowl, as “GLP-1 Friendly.” Chicken is the highest-protein filling, with 32 g in a 4 oz serving.

items.name: Double High Protein Bowl
items.custom_order_tip: Order it as listed: double adobo chicken, light white rice, black beans, fajita veggies, tomato salsa, cheese, and extra romaine.

items.name: Double High Protein Burrito
items.custom_order_tip: Want fewer calories? The Double High Protein Bowl has 2 g more protein and 80 fewer calories.

items.name: High Protein-High Fiber Bowl
items.custom_order_tip: Order it as listed: adobo chicken, light brown rice, black beans, fajita veggies, corn salsa, tomato salsa, and lettuce.

items.name: High Protein - Low Calorie Bowl
items.custom_order_tip: Adobo chicken on a supergreens base with fajita veggies, salsa, and guacamole. Most of the fat comes from the guac.

items.name: High Protein Cup - Pollo Asado
items.custom_order_tip: Add it to any bowl or salad for 37 g more protein.

items.name: High Protein Cup - Chicken (4 oz)
items.custom_order_tip: This is the same 4 oz chicken that goes in a bowl. Ask for double chicken, or add a cup on the side, for 32 g more protein.

items.name: High Protein Taco
items.custom_order_tip: Order three for 45 g of protein.

items.name: Beef Barbacoa (4 oz)
items.custom_order_tip: Add black beans (8 g protein per serving) to a barbacoa bowl for 32 g.

items.name: Sofritas (4 oz)
items.custom_order_tip: Plant-based. Add black beans (8 g) and cheese (6 g) to raise the protein.
